quotes.text: Hold the handles, gently tighten your abs, and keep the front of your hips in contact with the pad.
quotes.closest: Hold the handles, gently tighten your abs, and keep the front of your hips in contact with the pad.

quotes.text: Stop when you reach the end of your controlled range or before your hips begin to lift.
quotes.closest: Stop when you reach the end of your controlled range or before your hips begin to lift.

quotes.text: If the load pulls your pelvis off the bench, reduce the weight or stop the curl slightly earlier. Lifting the hips changes the position of the hamstrings and often introduces lower-back movement that does not help the target action.
quotes.closest: If the load pulls your pelvis off the bench, reduce the weight or stop the curl slightly earlier. Lifting the hips changes the position of the hamstrings and often introduces lower-back movement that does not help the target action.

quotes.text: Curl the Legs: Bend your knees to lift the weighted lever towards your glutes. Keep your hips pressed against the pad.
quotes.closest: Curl the Legs: Bend your knees to lift the weighted lever towards your glutes. Keep your hips pressed against the pad.

quotes.text: Slowly exhale and contract your hamstrings, flexing (bending) the knees and moving the resistance pad i na controlled manner towards your butt. Avoid arching your back during this movement.
quotes.closest: Slowly exhale and contract your hamstrings, flexing (bending) the knees and moving the resistance pad i na controlled manner towards your butt.  Avoid arching your back during this movement.
